objectives.text:
Put a Formula into zone 1 and another into zone 5. At the start of each round, they are dropped and returned to those zones. 

 At the end of each round, each hero scores its controller 1 point if in zone 3, 2 points if in zone 4, or 3 points if in zone 5. 

 At the end of round 7, or if a player has 10 or more points at the end of a round, the player with the most points wins.
